final_message:
I fixed the following issues:

- In export.py, updated to_csv_row to properly quote names containing commas or double quotes according to RFC 4180.
- In pricing.py, updated parse_price to handle commas in prices and accounting-style negative prices with parentheses.
- In pricing.py, updated apply_discount to round using the commercial "round half up" rule.
- In report.py, fixed low_stock to include only items with quantity strictly below the threshold and to return names sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

After these fixes, all tests pass successfully.
